name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 11 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-08-25, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
